criteria.statement: System discovery publishes a deterministically ordered observed_deployments array containing only environment-service states whose current observation ID matches the authoritative latest runtime observation.
System discovery and relay policy events publish when browser relay policy is configured and nostr.sidecar.enabled is false.
Settings > Versions renders observed_deployments as runtime truth and never infers observed rows from versions.components.
Compile-time frontend and backend artifact metadata remains visible only under a Build information label that states it is not deployment evidence.
